text:
Ravi Kumar: quick heads-up — while testing onboarding flows I hit duplicate side-effects in the node sampleapp when a token refresh happened during a 429 backoff. single button click, two webhook posts.

Elena Park: dang. can you share the repro steps?

Ravi Kumar: yep, minimal: start sampleapp local, click `checkout`, flip creds with `./scripts/rotate_creds.sh` while the client is backing off, and set jitter=0 to make timing deterministic. logs: 
```
[2026-03-23T09:10:01Z] INFO req=aa1 status=429
[2026-03-23T09:10:01Z] INFO backoff_ms=200 jitter=0 req=aa1
[2026-03-23T09:10:01Z] WARN token rotated during backoff
[2026-03-23T09:10:02Z] INFO req=aa1 status=200 side_effect=applied
[2026-03-23T09:10:03Z] INFO req=aa1_retry status=200 side_effect=applied  <-- duplicate
```

Ivy: looks like Idempotency-Key got dropped on the resumed attempt. node helper rebuilds headers after refresh.

Elena Park: parity note: go/python keep the idempotency header; node was leaving it to caller. we should change node to persist it across refresh/resume.

node-sdk-bot: ISSUE created: DEVEX-1199 "node sdk: persist Idempotency-Key across token refresh and resume" assigned to @Ravi.

Ravi Kumar: plan proposal in PR: (1) stash idempotency-key in retry context before token refresh, (2) ensure resume path merges preserved headers back, (3) add unit + e2e chaos test `tests/chaos/replay_token_rotate.js`.

Elena Park: agree. also set default jitter=true for 429/backoff in node SDK so deterministic test envs opt-out, but normal runs avoid synchronized retries. add opt-out flag `JITTER=false` for CI.

qa-bot: queued CI job: devex/sampleapp#replay-check (reproduce-token-rotate-429)

Ravi Kumar: tiny debate: server-side dedupe window — what default? seen races ~1-3s; i'd vote 8s safe_replay_window_ms by default in sampleapp and docs.

Elena Park: +1 to 8s. add docs blurb: "Store Idempotency-Key through token refresh; SDKs preserve it by default. Use server-side dedupe for extra safety."

Ravi Kumar: PR opened: github.com/redwood/devex/node-sdk/pull/321. added README test command `./scripts/run_replay_test.sh` and a small note in quickstart.

node-sdk-bot: CI passed on PR 321. ready for review.

Elena Park: i'll review and then we can cut 0.10.2 micro-release. also add telemetry `sdk.replay.attempt` with tag reason=token_rotate so ops can alert on duplicates.

Ravi Kumar: thanks — will follow up with parity matrix run for go/python/node. leaving the repro branch for now: `devex/node-replay-guard`.

Ivy: closing loop: add sampleapp chaos test to nightly CI after release.

Ravi Kumar: thanks all :thumbsup:
